title: Install the portal in the hosting images

costar.context: The Windows debug exe was a local check. Hosting is the Linux image: Dockerfile, Dockerfile.fdb, and the runtime stages in Dockerfile.build. The process workdir in those images is /var/lib/shippin.tech.
costar.objective: Build the Svelte portal inside those images and serve it from /usr/share/shippin.tech/portal.
costar.style: One plan, then the image path.
costar.response: The hosted process reads the portal installed in the image. A set directory overrides that path.

concerns: ui/build is relative to the process working directory. The image working directory is /var/lib/shippin.tech, so that relative path is empty.
The catalog build reads resources/schema/schema.json.gz from beside ui/.
A VERSION file must not be added to the portal directory.
context: The runtime images already set shippin.tech_HEALTHCHECK_URL and run /usr/local/bin/shippin.tech as user shippin.tech. The portal lookup uses shippin.tech_PORTAL_DIR when that directory contains 200.html.
current_state: The runtime images build the Svelte portal and set shippin.tech_PORTAL_DIR to /usr/share/shippin.tech/portal. The lookup uses that install path when no override directory contains 200.html.
target_design: A node stage runs npm run build with the schema file beside ui/. Each runtime image copies that build to /usr/share/shippin.tech/portal and sets shippin.tech_PORTAL_DIR. The lookup uses a set directory, then the install path, then ui/build.
changes: Add the portal build stage and the install path to the three Dockerfiles.
Choose the first candidate directory that contains 200.html.
boundaries: Do not add a VERSION file.
Do not restart the running one-node process.
Do not post a set, a live delivery, or a live action.

verification.name: portal-install-path
verification.proves: A set directory wins, the install path is next, ui/build is last, and the runtime Dockerfiles install the portal there.

verification.name: image-portal-stage
verification.proves: The Linux image stage builds the Svelte portal.
verification.result: docker is not installed on this machine, so the stage was not built here. Dockerfile, Dockerfile.fdb, and Dockerfile.build each contain the portal stage, npm run build, the copy to /usr/share/shippin.tech/portal, and shippin.tech_PORTAL_DIR.
